title: Bars Unknown: Vegas Strip Speakeasies, Dives & Gems

requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health

Strict 21+ Physical ID Required: You must bring a legal, physical government-issued photo ID or driver’s license. Digital IDs on phones or paper temporary IDs are NOT accepted by casino security. International guests must bring a physical passport or I.D. If you don't have proper physical ID, bartenders or security will not let you enter the venues.

Weather & Health: This tour operates rain or shine. Because it involves a moderate amount of walking through crowded casino floors, it is recommended for travelers with clean bills of health and no severe mobility restrictions.
policies: This is a Walking Tour: Mostly Indoors. We move on foot to hit multiple spots via resort shortcuts. Please wear comfortable walking shoes. No buses or outside transportation are used.
Casual but presentable. To ensure smooth entry into the hidden speakeasies, men should avoid swimwear, athletic jerseys, gym shorts, cut-offs, or sandals.
Cash & Card Needed: Our first stop (Casino Royale) is a legendary local dive that is cash-only for their best drink deals. Cards are perfectly fine for the rest of the crawl.
Open Containers: It is 100% legal to walk the Las Vegas Strip with an open plastic cup or aluminum can, so we can grab drinks to go between stops.
Drinks are Out-of-Pocket: You pay for your own drinks as we go. This keeps your upfront booking cost low and gives you total freedom over what you drink and spend.
Health - if you have walking issues or any health issues, don't book!
Drinking - we go to at least 5 bars - no amatuers allowed!
If you have problems walking, health issue and/or you're a mean drunk, not for you
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Hey everyone, I'm Jonathan & I enjoy the off-the-beaten-path bars & good deals! I developed this bar-crawl to counter the stereo-typical party-bus nightclub-crawl where you're herded on a bus with 50+ amateurs being served "free seltzers" and cheap vodka drinks. This is a walking experience to the lesser-known hidden gems, the ones most tourist miss if venturing alone. I've done bar-crawls around the world and most are 3 or 4 spots only, you wait to get in, wait to sit, wait long for overpriced mediocre drinks & they're not really special or hidden.

This is a mix of several bars. Some are cheap, some have happy hours, some are divey or hidden spots that most people walk right by. Drinks not included which means you can budget what you wanna spend & decide what you want to drink rather than being forced a specific menu and price.

All the bars are walking distance. Some are to-go spots, some we can sit & relax. The goal is to have fun & introduce you to something unknown!
